notes.title: Linux version has been released!
notes.content:
Hi Linux guys, ːsteamhappyː we brought Karma to Linux platform. 

For those who are using 64 bit Linux system, you may need to manually install some 32 bit libraries. Use "ldd" and "apt-get install" wisely :)

Also, if you are trying to execute Karma directly (not from Steam client), the executable file is "Karma.x86" in the root of game directory.

I don't know much about Linux system. If you have more issues about launching the game, try Google or stackoverflow. :p

BTW, the game has an update of some goods' effects.
